name: Manwad
source: Graceful yet lethal, as treacherous as a hidden reef, Queen Manwad—known as the Kraken's Bride— commands the Blood Sails pirates with unparalleled ruthlessness and skill. Under her merciless leadership, the Blood Sails have become the ultimate terror of the Sea of Knives, their infamy growing twice as fearsome during her reign.
